title: Hesperetin promotes bladder cancer cells death via the PI3K/AKT pathway by network pharmacology and molecular docking.
authors: Lv, Yue; Liu, Zhonghao; Deng, Leihong; Xia, Shunyao; Mu, Qingchun; Xiao, Bang; Xiu, Youcheng; Liu, Zan
one_liner_zh: 通过网络药理学和分子对接研究橙皮素经PI3K/AKT通路促进膀胱癌细胞死亡，分子对接仅用于小分子-蛋白结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Patients with bladder cancer (BLCA) still show high recurrence after surgery and chemotherapy. Hesperetin (HE), as a natural compound, has attracted researchers' attention due to its low toxicity and easy access. However, the inhibitory effect of HE on BLCA remains unknown. The hub genes and enrichment pathways regulated by HE in the treatment of BLCA were predicted by network pharmacology. The molecular docking of HE and hub proteins was visualized. Colony and CCK8 assays were used to test cell proliferation, and BLCA migration was confirmed by transwell and wound healing assays. In addition, the occurrence of apoptosis and ferroptosis was demonstrated by Hoechst staining, transmission electron microscopy (TEM) and ROS (reactive oxygen species) assay. Western Blotting was performed to validate the hub proteins, target functions and pathways. SRC, PIK3R1 and MAPK1 were identified as hub targets for HE in BLCA, involving the PI3k/AKT pathway. Furthermore, HE inhibited the proliferation and migration of BLCA cells. The MMP2/MMP9 proteins were significantly inhibited by HE. The increased expression of Bax and cleaved caspase-3 indicated that HE could promote BLCA cell apoptosis. In addition, Hoechst staining revealed concentrated and illuminated apoptotic nuclei. The activation of ROS and the decline of GPX4 expression suggested that HE might induce ferroptosis as an anti-BLCA process. Shrunk mitochondria and apoptotic bodies were observed in BLCA cells treated with HE, with reduced or absent mitochondrial cristae. We propose for the first time that HE could inhibit the proliferation and migration of BLCA cells and promote apoptosis and ferroptosis. HE may act by targeting proteins such as SRC, PIK3R1 and MAPK1 and the PI3K/AKT pathway.
abstract_zh: 膀胱癌（BLCA）患者术后及化疗后仍表现出高复发率。橙皮素（HE）作为一种天然化合物，因其低毒性和易获取性而受到研究者关注。然而，HE对BLCA的抑制作用尚不明确。通过网络药理学预测了HE治疗BLCA中调控的核心基因和富集通路。对HE与核心蛋白的分子对接进行了可视化。采用集落形成和CCK8实验检测细胞增殖，并通过transwell和划痕愈合实验确认BLCA迁移。此外，通过Hoechst染色、透射电子显微镜（TEM）和ROS（活性氧）实验证明了凋亡和铁死亡的发生。采用Western Blotting验证核心蛋白、靶点功能和通路。SRC、PIK3R1和MAPK1被确定为HE在BLCA中的核心靶点，涉及PI3k/AKT通路。进一步地，HE抑制了BLCA细胞的增殖和迁移。MMP2/MMP9蛋白被HE显著抑制。Bax和cleaved caspase-3表达增加表明HE能促进BLCA细胞凋亡。此外，Hoechst染色显示浓缩且发亮的凋亡细胞核。ROS的激活和GPX4表达的下降提示HE可能诱导铁死亡作为抗BLCA过程。在HE处理的BLCA细胞中观察到线粒体萎缩和凋亡小体，线粒体嵴减少或缺失。我们首次提出HE能抑制BLCA细胞的增殖和迁移，并促进凋亡和铁死亡。HE可能通过靶向SRC、PIK3R1和MAPK1等蛋白及PI3K/AKT通路发挥作用。
